rationale: The Court is most likely to resolve the case narrowly on the FTCA’s § 1346(b)(1) “law of the place/private person” predicate, holding that state-law justifications/privileges that negate tortiousness defeat the claim even when § 2680(h) removes the federal intentional-tort bar. Separate writings are most likely to debate whether officer-specific state “privileges” and/or the discretionary-function exception risk making the law-enforcement proviso ineffectual.
